question: Which seed syllables are to be written in sequence outside the sixteen-petaled lotus?
premises: The syllable aṃ and other seed syllables are specified.
They are to be placed in order.
Their location is outside the sixteen-petaled lotus.
inference: One should write aṃ and the other seed syllables in sequence outside the sixteen-petaled lotus.
uncertainties: The full list of bījāni beyond aṃ is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: And one should write the syllable aṃ and the other seed syllables in order outside the sixteen-petaled lotus.
